issues.description: Extraction requires data/stories/manifest.json and per-story files, but the repo ships an empty data/stories directory so the main demo path fails.
The advertised demo script starts with extract --tiny, which currently fails before producing vectors because required story data is absent.
The only end-to-end test is failing, so the repository has no passing integration coverage for the advertised pipeline.
Tiny extraction passes the true emotion label into the backend, leaking labels into activations and making validation results circular.
Emotion detection uses substring counts, causing false positives such as unhappy triggering happy and unafraid triggering afraid.
pca_components_for_variance accepts threshold 0 but still returns one component instead of returning no components.
Loaded vector artifacts are not validated against the selected backend/config, allowing stale or incompatible vectors to be used until a late shape error or misleading output.
Preference steering also loads vector artifacts without checking backend, model, dimensions, or emotion compatibility.
For non-fast tokenizers, HF steering falls back to steering every prompt token instead of only activity tokens.
HF preference scoring is a single good-minus-bad continuation score, not an actual pairwise preference judgment as described by the validation method.
The default config selects the HF backend, but base installation does not include torch or transformers, so default CLI usage fails unless optional extras are known and installed.
Config values are coerced but not validated for required emotions, positive topic/story counts, nonnegative token_start, or sane PCA thresholds before runtime.
Saving artifacts assumes every configured emotion has data and will raise a late KeyError instead of reporting missing or empty emotion data clearly.
